def test_18_continuous_non_grid_events_and_multihop(self):
    c=FIXTURES.synthetic(T=30.,connected=True,capacity=8.,
        segments=[TrafficSegment(0.,.25,{'f':2.}),TrafficSegment(.25,1.75,{'f':4.}),TrafficSegment(1.75,20.,{'f':2.})])
    c.engine.fixed_edges=((FIXTURES.B,FIXTURES.C),)
    # Rebuild from zero so the frozen engine alone initializes the route.
    ObservedD2Engine = FIXTURES.ObservedD2Engine
    from dynamic_lisl.commodity import Commodity
    engine=ObservedD2Engine(c.engine.nodes,((FIXTURES.B,FIXTURES.C),),8.,
        [Commodity('f',FIXTURES.A,FIXTURES.C)],c.engine.trace,lambda edge,t:1.,c.engine.executor)
    c=FIXTURES.wrap(engine,c.validator.physical,30.);c.advance_to(3.)
    r=root(c,'ZERO');s=score_action(r,Hold(),COST)
    b=s['n2_result']['n1b_result']
    self.assertGreaterEqual(b['mean_delivered_fluid_delay_s'],2.)
    self.assertEqual(s['n2_result']['n1b_result']['n1a_result']['offered_bits'],9.)
    self.assertEqual(b['delivered_bits'],9.)

def test_18_continuous_non_grid_events_and_multihop(self):

    c.engine.fixed_edges=((FIXTURES.B,FIXTURES.C),)
    # Rebuild from zero so the frozen engine alone initializes the route.
    from runtime.n1b_observer import ObservedD2Engine
    from dynamic_lisl.commodity import Commodity
    engine=ObservedD2Engine(c.engine.nodes,((FIXTURES.B,FIXTURES.C),),8.,
        [Commodity('f',FIXTURES.A,FIXTURES.C)],c.engine.trace,lambda edge,t:1.,c.engine.executor)
    c=FIXTURES.wrap(engine,c.validator.physical,30.);c.advance_to(3.)
    r=root(c,'ZERO');s=score_action(r,Hold(),COST)
    b=s['n2_result']['n1b_result']
    self.assertGreaterEqual(b['mean_delivered_fluid_delay_s'],2.)
